howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: A real sequence. Nothing waits in silence.
howItWorks.step1Body: Upload from your phone — camera works. Files are encrypted before storage.
howItWorks.step2Body: Each plan is a fixed price, a named doctor and the number of visits.
howItWorks.step3Body: 10% to confirm (or $100, whichever is more). The balance is paid at the clinic.
howItWorks.step4Body: Named coordinator, driver with your flight number, hotel pre-checked.
howItWorks.step5Body: You know every visit in advance. The clinic marks each visit done.
howItWorks.step6Body: Messages at 7, 30 and 90 days — a doctor can answer, not a form.

is-it-safe.q: Is it safe to have treatment abroad?
is-it-safe.a: Only partner clinics with a verified license, insurance and a written warranty are offered. Every clinic is visited in person by our team before a patient is sent.

how-is-price-fixed.a: The clinic reviews your files and sends a plan with a fixed price in writing. The price shown to you equals the clinic's quote; our fee is on non-medical items only (hotel, transfer).

what-if-complication.q: What happens if there's a complication?
what-if-complication.a: Follow-up messages at 7, 30 and 90 days route medical questions back to the clinic and your coordinator. Warranty details are set per clinic in writing.

how-many-visits.a: Dental implants typically need two visits (surgery, then the crown). Hair transplant is one visit. The procedure page lists visits and stay length.

what-about-warranty.a: Five years on implants and one year on grafts, in writing from the clinic. Specifics are on each clinic's page.

can-i-bring-companion.q: Can I bring someone with me?
can-i-bring-companion.a: Yes — tell us when you fill in the request. Hotels and transfers are planned for the number of travellers.

what-languages.q: In which languages are you available?
what-languages.a: English, Russian and Hebrew at launch. Arabic and German are coming.

how-pay-deposit.q: How do I pay the deposit?
how-pay-deposit.a: Online by card after you accept an offer. The balance is paid at the clinic.

procedureImplants.title: Dental implants in Tbilisi
procedureImplants.intro: Fixed price per implant, in writing, from a checked clinic. Two visits, around six nights.
procedureImplants.whatIsItBody: A titanium post placed in the jawbone replaces the root of a lost tooth. After healing the final crown is fitted.
procedureImplants.whoItSuitsBody: Adults with a missing tooth and healthy bone, or who can have a bone graft. Not for uncontrolled diabetes or smokers mid-treatment.
procedureImplants.visitsBody: First visit: 2–3 days for implant placement. Second visit after healing: 2–3 days for the crown.

about.title: About Medtour Georgia
about.intro: A small team in Tbilisi that organises medical trips. Dentistry first, hair and skin next.
about.missionBody: Make the right clinic abroad as easy to pick as the right one at home. Fixed prices, named doctors, one coordinator from the first message to the last follow-up.
about.teamBody: Six coordinators, three medical reviewers, one legal advisor. Nobody takes a case they can't personally see through.
about.warrantyBody: Every partner clinic signs a warranty in English. Five years on implants, two on crowns and veneers, one year on hair grafts. If a complication appears inside that window and inside the written scope, the clinic replaces or revises at no extra charge.
about.timeline1: Two founders, one dental partner, one coordinator.
about.timeline2: First 100 patients, mostly from the UK diaspora.
about.timeline3: Three clinics vetted, hair transplant partner added, Hebrew-speaking coordinator hired.
about.timeline4: Site visits became mandatory. Written warranty standardised. 1,200+ patients since launch.
about.notAClinic: We are an organiser of medical trips, not a healthcare provider. All clinical decisions belong to the named doctor at the clinic.

whyUsItems.a: Fixed price before you fly — in writing, signed by the dentist.
